target.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add escapeHtml seam and collapse six copies
target.body:
Closes #105949

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a maintenance and consistency problem where six HTML escaping implementations across Canvas, Diffs, Telegram Mini App, Workspaces, and QA Lab had to be reviewed independently and had already drifted on apostrophe handling.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one dependency-free, five-entity `escapeHtml(value: string): string` export to the existing lightweight `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` entrypoint, then migrates all six callers and deletes their local copies. The seam pays rent immediately across five plugins without adding another SDK subpath.

Output compatibility by sink:

- Canvas and Diffs retain their byte-identical five-entity behavior.
- Telegram Mini App retains five-entity escaping for its double-quoted nonce attribute.
- Workspaces and QA Lab insert raw values once into HTML text nodes. Apostrophes now serialize as `'`, which renders identically and closes their four-entity gap; no caller passes pre-escaped markup or double-escapes output.
- XML/SSML-specific `escapeXml` helpers in Active Memory and Voice Call remain intentionally out of scope.

The Plugin SDK API hash and public surface budgets move by exactly one export and one callable export. The generated subpath documentation now names the HTML helper.

## User Impact

Plugin authors and maintainers get one supported HTML escaping contract instead of six copies. Existing rendered output is unchanged; generated Workspaces and QA Lab HTML now consistently entity-encodes apostrophes.

AI-assisted implementation; reviewed and understood by the maintainer workflow.

## Evidence

Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox: `tbx_01kxcrjkpn9pn1w1cwc9dwkfga` ([hydration run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29221938482)).

Passed remotely:

- `pnpm test src/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime.test.ts`
- `pnpm test extensions/canvas`
- `pnpm test extensions/diffs`
- `pnpm test extensions/telegram`
- `pnpm test extensions/workspaces`
- `pnpm test extensions/qa-lab`
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check`
- targeted `pnpm format:check`
- `pnpm build`
- `OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK=0 node scripts/profile-extension-memory.mjs --extension telegram --skip-combined --concurrency 1`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`: clean, no findings, 0.96 confidence

`pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` measures the intended exact totals (`10640` public exports, `5356` callable exports) against the updated pins. It remains red only on pre-existing `main` deprecated-surface drift: total deprecated exports `3284 > 3279`, `conversation-runtime` `4 > 0`, and `channel-pairing` `1 > 0`. The same three failures reproduce on base commit `b43e832fcc8000ed7287c7accc54e381db607f85`; this change adds no deprecated export.

`pnpm check:changed` likewise reaches the repository LOC ratchet and reports unrelated current-`main` growth. The two touched oversized files moved downward and their shrink-only baselines were updated exactly: Diffs `793 -> 785`, QA Lab Discord runtime `1964 -> 1957`.
